mapper.select: SELECT * FROM provider_sync_checkpoint WHERE connection_id=#{connectionId} AND sync_type=#{syncType} AND language=#{language}
SELECT * FROM provider_sync_checkpoint WHERE connection_id=#{connectionId} ORDER BY language,sync_type
SELECT * FROM provider_sync_checkpoint WHERE connection_id=#{connectionId} AND language=#{language} AND status IN ('REQUESTED','RUNNING') ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_sync_checkpoint (connection_id,sync_type,language,status,page_no,page_size) VALUES (#{connectionId},#{syncType},#{language},#{status},#{pageNo},#{pageSize}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE page_size=VALUES(page_size)
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_sync_checkpoint SET status='REQUESTED',requested_at=#{requestedAt},page_no=CASE WHEN #{restart} THEN 1 ELSE page_no END,update_time=CASE WHEN #{restart} AND sync_type='FULL' THEN NULL ELSE update_time END,total_fetched=CASE WHEN #{restart} THEN 0 ELSE total_fetched END,total_upserted=CASE WHEN #{restart} THEN 0 ELSE total_upserted END,inserted_count=CASE WHEN #{restart} THEN 0 ELSE inserted_count END,updated_count=CASE WHEN #{restart} THEN 0 ELSE updated_count END,skipped_count=CASE WHEN #{restart} THEN 0 ELSE skipped_count END,error_count=CASE WHEN #{restart} THEN 0 ELSE error_count END,last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status != 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM provider_sync_checkpoint WHERE (status IN ('REQUESTED','FAILED') OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now})) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(requested_at,updated_at) ASC,id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_sync_checkpoint candidate SET status='RUNNING',started_at=#{now},lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND (status IN ('REQUESTED','FAILED') OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now})) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT /*+ NO_MERGE(active) */ 1 FROM (SELECT id,connection_id,language,status,lease_until FROM provider_sync_checkpoint) active WHERE active.connection_id=candidate.connection_id AND active.language=candidate.language AND active.id<>candidate.id AND active.status='RUNNING' AND (active.lease_until IS NULL OR active.lease_until > #{now}))

UPDATE provider_sync_checkpoint SET page_no=#{pageNo},update_time=#{updateTime},total_fetched=total_fetched+#{fetched},total_upserted=total_upserted+#{upserted},inserted_count=inserted_count+#{inserted},updated_count=updated_count+#{updated},skipped_count=skipped_count+#{skipped},error_count=error_count+#{errors},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}

UPDATE provider_sync_checkpoint SET status='SUCCESS',page_no=#{pageNo},update_time=#{updateTime},last_success_at=#{finishedAt},finished_at=#{finishedAt},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}

UPDATE provider_sync_checkpoint SET status='FAILED',finished_at=#{finishedAt},error_count=error_count+1,last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}
